name: Gekka
source:
A former reconnaissance doll with a childlike body.

She has a coarse mouth, just as a soldier would.
She dutifully does what she's told, but her attitude is aloof and disinterested.

She is very cautious when it comes to interpersonal relationships, and doesn't want to get closer to other people beyond a certain line.

Favorite food: Taiyaki
Dream: To receive a new mission

[From [url=https://key.visualarts.gr.jp/primadoll/]official site[/url]]
